properties.name: Newfoundland & Labrador marine area
properties.description: Operational area for CryoLens: the Labrador Shelf and Labrador Sea, the Northeast Newfoundland Shelf, and the Grand Banks including Flemish Cap. This is Iceberg Alley, the corridor along which Baffin Bay and Greenland-calved icebergs drift south past the Labrador coast to the Grand Banks.
properties.northern_limit_note: 60.5 N approximates Cape Chidley, the northern tip of Labrador. Acquisitions extending beyond it are retained when their centre falls inside the AOI.
properties.southern_limit_note: 42.5 N covers the Tail of the Grand Bank.

properties.name: Labrador Shelf sub-region
properties.description: Northern sub-region: the main iceberg transit corridor along the Labrador coast.

properties.name: Grand Banks & NE Newfoundland Shelf sub-region
properties.description: Southern sub-region: offshore production fields (Hibernia, Terra Nova, White Rose) and the transatlantic shipping lanes.
